report.summary: Focused source-context closure audit of frozen range 57e954fe→910281a4 (7 files: docs/reviews acceptance/findings/initial-audit/runtime receipts, proof script, and two test files). The range contains no production-source changes, consistent with the acceptance claim that only tests and evidence are new since 3294b05a. I explicitly inspected the attributed source bodies the initial audit could not: (1) _same includes period_start in its (unit, period_start, period_end) comparison while cash is pre-filtered to instant facts, so a duration 'Current Marketable Securities' fact necessarily returns unavailable/incompatible_inputs — initial Low finding 1 is correctly disproved and the new test exercises that exact path; (2) _PRICE compiles with re.I, making the tempered lookahead's [A-Z] sentence guard case-insensitive, so lowercase sentence continuations cannot supply the optional conversion price — initial Low finding 2 is correctly disproved and the new parametrized test covers both cases; (3) the _Sections table producer emits ' ; ' row and ' | ' cell delimiters, and the committed fixture block-41 excerpt matches that serialization exactly; I traced _displayed_current_balance's regex successfully against the fixture's cash (666,096) and securities (178,645) rows inside the Current assets window, confirming the semicolon-serialization disposition and that newline variants fail closed; (4) arithmetic verifies: 666,096+178,645=844,741 thousands=844,741,000 USD, the fixture balance sheet cross-foots to 1,070,786 total current assets, and the lease rounding interval [2,955,150, 2,955,250) contains 2,955,158; (5) the presentation gate, corpus identity/cutoff/hash validation (document_access), pre-analyst acquisition ordering (create_source_acquisition calls prepare_document_sources before fan-out), maturity-before-as_of rejection (Review Focus 3), bounded shared brief, and EvidencePackage lineage validators all match the claimed fail-closed behaviors. The remaining initial Low dispositions (narrow DOCN 10-Q heading triple, historical Build2 fixture patch, cosmetic rendering) are accurately characterized, disclosed, and fail-closed. The disclosed summary-count discrepancy (six Low findings vs 'five' in the initial audit summary) is accurately recorded by the builder. Verdict: the focused independent source-context follow-up requirement is satisfied by this inspection; no Critical, High, or Medium findings in the audited range; two Low evidence-hygiene observations noted. This audit grants no integration or release authority.
limitations: Read-only audit of the frozen request.json only: no tests, ruff, or proof scripts were executed; the reported follow-up results (3239 passed/10 skipped full suite, 23 focused probes passed, stdout SHA 6d2ee1f9…) are builder-run evidence checked for internal consistency only.

The supplied source bodies carry asserted module SHA-256 hashes binding them to application commit 3294b05a; those hashes cannot be independently recomputed from frozen evidence, so verbatim-at-HEAD status rests on the asserted hashes plus strong internal consistency (fixture serialization, cross-footing arithmetic, matching producer/consumer formats).

tests/test_valuation.py's evidence() fixture (used by the new duration-security probe via facts[2]/facts[0]) is not in the frozen packet, so the probe's premise that the copied fact becomes a duration fact with a matching period_end was inferred from the asserted reason_code/message path rather than inspected.
Private proof inputs (saved November 7 DOCN state, cached SEC bytes, raw prompts, /tmp logs) are by design not audit inputs; only hashes and receipts quoted in the frozen evidence were checked.

The supplied source context is bounded to named bodies; omitted unrelated functions in the same modules (e.g., full sec_edgar.py tag-candidate logic, full context.py) were not inspected and are covered only by the first audit's review of changed B logic.
Remote exact-commit CI execution and any Machine 1 installation remain unverified, as the acceptance record itself discloses.

findings.title: Previously frozen runtime receipt and committed proof script were amended post-hoc (reopened_shared_brief_equal field and new shared_source_brief equality assertion) based on re-reading prior disposable outputs rather than a fresh recorded execution of the amended script; disclosed as 'reuse of valid output, not a new product run', but the referenced replay log predates the added assertion

New duration-security rejection probe depends on tests/test_valuation.evidence() internals (facts indices and period fields) not included in the frozen packet, so independent reviewers cannot confirm from frozen evidence alone that the constructed input is a genuine duration fact rather than a vacuous case; the asserted 'period mismatch' message makes the intended path plausible but uninspectable

Findings review and acceptance text contain run-together numerals/SHAs (e.g., 'matched77ebc8ab', 'completed27turns', '3239 passed,10 skipped') and carry forward the initial audit's five-vs-six Low count discrepancy; all are disclosed and do not alter substance, but they reduce the evidence record's machine- and human-readability
